Game Overview

In Tommy the Monkey Pilot, the core idea is straightforward: guide Tommy the Monkey through stormy skies in his triplane, collecting lost balloons and shimmering stars while dodging rainclouds. Test your piloting skills with simple controls as you embark on a whimsical aerial adventure to impress his sweetheart. Can you help Tommy succeed against the odds?
